Raudat Al Zuhur Reserve is especially appealing for wildflowers, grasses and visiting birds, with greenery developing after rain. At 30 SAR per person, it is an affordable nature outing. Allow 2–3 hours; open 06:30–18:00.

Hafat Al Sakhr Reserve combines rocky cliff scenery with desert vegetation and wildlife, offering a different landscape from the greener reserves. It costs 15 SAR per person. Allow 3–5 hours; open 06:00–17:30.

Rocky Rim Dune Safari provides scenic desert views while travelling by vehicle across dunes near a rocky escarpment. At 180 SAR per person, it fits your budget and adds a desert experience to your visit. Allow 3–5 hours; open 14:00–21:00.

Sama Al Riyadh Lookout complements the nature outings with elevated views across Riyadh, where you can identify landmarks and watch the light change over the rooftops. It costs 90 SAR per person. Allow 1–1.5 hours; open 11:00–22:00.
